<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.14"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="17" x2="334" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="17" x2="338" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="12" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="12" x2="354" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="12" x2="357" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="7" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="9" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="386" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Branded header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="112" fill="#D52B1E"/>
  <circle cx="332" cy="42" r="76" fill="#F68E5A" opacity="0.62" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <circle cx="382" cy="115" r="70" fill="#FDC82F" opacity="0.52" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <polyline points="34,87 24,96 34,105" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="96" x2="48" y2="96" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="70" y="102" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Your cart</text>
  <circle cx="347" cy="94" r="25" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="337" y="87" width="20" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="87" x2="341" y2="83" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="87" x2="353" y2="83" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="106" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="353" cy="106" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Empty state surface -->
  <rect x="22" y="168" width="346" height="470" rx="30" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
  <rect x="22" y="164" width="346" height="470" rx="30" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="310" r="122" fill="#F7D8AB" opacity="0.66"/>
  <circle cx="294" cy="246" r="34" fill="#FFEA28" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="398" r="27" fill="#F8B756" opacity="0.72"/>

  <!-- Shopping bag / cart illustration -->
  <rect x="112" y="262" width="166" height="116" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="130" y="282" width="130" height="76" rx="10" fill="#D52B1E"/>
  <line x1="150" y1="282" x2="150" y2="358" stroke="#AB2D1F" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55"/>
  <line x1="240" y1="282" x2="240" y2="358" stroke="#AB2D1F" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55"/>
  <polyline points="151,283 151,249 160,238 171,249 171,283" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <polyline points="210,283 210,249 219,238 230,249 230,283" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="160" cy="345" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="242" cy="345" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M163 313 Q195 337 227 313" fill="none" stroke="#FFEA28" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="187" cy="301" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="204" cy="301" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <text x="195" y="426" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Your cart is empty</text>
  <text x="195" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#525252">Good food is only a few taps away.</text>
  <text x="195" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#525252">Start an order and make it a meal.</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="77" y="518" width="236" height="58" rx="29" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <text x="195" y="554" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Order now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful strip -->
  <rect x="38" y="658" width="314" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="696" r="19" fill="#FFEA28"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="687" x2="68" y2="701" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="706" r="1.8" fill="#000000"/>
  <text x="98" y="689" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Hungry for something?</text>
  <text x="98" y="711" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8B8B8B">Browse your favorites and discover more.</text>
  <polyline points="326,691 333,697 326,703" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation shadow and bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="762" width="390" height="82" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" rx="26" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="756" x2="360" y2="756" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="41,788 51,779 61,788" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="44" y="787" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Menu -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="789" r="13" fill="#FFF4B0"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="784" x2="135" y2="784" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="789" x2="135" y2="789" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="794" x2="135" y2="794" stroke="#525252" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="128" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Menu</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cart selected -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="789" r="17" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <rect x="187" y="783" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="190" y1="783" x2="190" y2="780" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="200" y1="783" x2="200" y2="780" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="799" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="799" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#D52B1E">Cart</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Rewards -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="262,777 265,785 274,785 267,790 270,798 262,793 255,798 257,790 250,785 259,785" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="262" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Rewards</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="784" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="798" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="337" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8A8A8A">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
